summary: Package ships only an HTML page with obfuscated client-side JavaScript as its main entry
details: The tarball contains a single HTML file declared as the package's main entry and no other code. package.json declares no lifecycle scripts, so npm install executes nothing from the package. The main entry is an HTML document (a Cloudflare Turnstile-themed 'Just a moment...' challenge page containing a heavily obfuscated inline _0x...-style JavaScript block), which is not valid JavaScript, so require() or import of this package in Node would fail without executing the embedded script. The obfuscated code only runs if the HTML is rendered in a browser; it does not touch the installer's filesystem, environment, credentials, or network. The package appears to be using npm as hosting/staging for a browser-side page rather than as a Node library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
